BV1FsJ86TEwP.ingredients: Guifei pork, sweet peppers, onion, garlic, black pepper sauce and a little oil.
BV1FsJ86TEwP.quantities: 1 spoon of black pepper sauce. Meat weight, spoon capacity and frying time are unspecified.

Pan fry directly until browned and cooked.
Add peppers, onion and garlic, then 1 spoon of black pepper sauce. Stir fry and serve.

BV1wfJD6eEWu.ingredients: Sliced bread, minced beef, red onion, egg, grated cheese and a little oil. The pale fat spread on the outside resembles butter but is not named.
BV1wfJD6eEWu.quantities: 1 egg is shown; the creator suggests 2 if more meat needs binding. About 10 g nuts accompany the meal. Bread and meat weights are absent.
steps: Chop red onion, spray the pan with a little oil, add beef and cook, spreading the mixture evenly.
Mix in an egg and press two bread slices over the filling so it adheres, then turn.
Add grated cheese over the filling and bring the slices together.
Spread a little pale fat on the outside and toast both sides until golden. Cut and serve with cucumber and about 10 g nuts.
BV1wfJD6eEWu.missing: Any beef seasoning, cheese type, exact spreading fat and cooking time are unspecified.

BV1wfJD6eEWu.ingredients: Beef shanks, onion, cinnamon bark, star anise, bay leaves, dried tangerine peel, rock sugar, soy sauce, salt, Guangdong rice wine, water and a little oil. Spices are visually identified.
BV1wfJD6eEWu.quantities: 2 shanks and about half a bowl of soy sauce; rest covered for 2–3 hours after cooking. Meat weight, bowl size, wine amount and cooking duration are not established.
steps: Prepare the shanks and place in the rice cooker.
Fry onion and spices in a little oil; add water to carry the pan flavors into the cooker.
Add dried peel, rock sugar, half a bowl of soy sauce, a little salt and rice wine, and start cooking.
Keep covered for 2–3 hours after the cooking cycle, as stated.
BV1wfJD6eEWu.missing: Cooking minutes and water quantity are not clearly given here. The 48-minute setting from another video is not silently imported.

BV1uaJy6ZEL6.ingredients: Fish, cuttlefish, shrimp, butter, minced garlic, lemon zest and slices, black pepper salt and a little oil. The fish species is unspecified.

Pan fry both sides of the fish in a little oil and remove.
Separately fry cuttlefish and shrimp; when they change color, add lemon zest, butter and garlic.
Season with black pepper salt, toss and plate with the fish. Season the fish lightly too and add lemon slices.

BV1RXJ66oE9B.ingredients: Diaolong beef, black pepper salt, baking soda, cornstarch, oil, soy sauce, sugar, water, mixed peppers, garlic, onion and shiso leaves.
BV1RXJ66oE9B.quantities: Cut beef about a finger's width and marinate for about 30 minutes. Meat weight and seasoning proportions are unspecified.
steps: Cut beef into thick pieces and mix with black pepper salt, a little baking soda, cornstarch, oil, soy sauce, sugar and water. Marinate about 30 minutes.
Cut peppers and onion, prepare garlic and pick the shiso leaves.
Sear the beef until browned, turn, then add peppers, onion and garlic.
Add shiso near the end, toss and serve. The later batch prepared in advance is covered and refrigerated.
